dct_title_s: Explanatory map of City of Minneapolis showing the existing and contemplated park and parkway system with suggestions for future extensions and connections, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: This map shows the existing and contemplated park and parkway system in Minneapolis, Minnesota as of 1907. The map is found in the Twenty-fifth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis.
